title: OMT protocol common definitions (v1)
description: Shared vocabulary for the OMT JSON-RPC protocol. Wire fields are camelCase; enum values keep the domain's snake_case spelling (in_progress, awaiting_confirmation, ...). Wire objects deliberately do NOT set additionalProperties:false so that additive changes are tolerated by older peers.

HomeId.description: Stable public identifier of one OMT home. Every public reference in the protocol must be qualified with a HomeId (R4). Bare filesystem/workspace paths are DSH-adapter compatibility inputs and are resolved to a HomeId before anything crosses the wire.

NodeId.description: Ticket node identifier within one home, e.g. TICKET-0001, EPIC-0003.

RunId.description: Run identifier within one home, e.g. RUN-0001.

Revision.description: Optimistic-concurrency revision counter of a node or run.

Iso8601Time.description: UTC timestamp in ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 form.

ProtocolVersion.description: Protocol version as MAJOR.MINOR. Peers agree on the highest shared MAJOR; a request whose MAJOR is not supported fails with problem code UNSUPPORTED_PROTOCOL.

QualifiedNodeRef.description: A node reference qualified by its owning home (R4).

QualifiedRunRef.description: A run reference qualified by its owning home (R4).

NodeType.description: Ticket hierarchy node type. Hierarchy rules: epic→story, story→substory|ticket, substory→ticket, ticket→subticket; only epic may be a root.

NodeStatus.description: Ticket workflow status. Archived is an independent read-only dimension carried beside the status.

Archived.description: Read-only archival dimension: archived nodes are frozen and excluded from runs.

Priority.description: Sort priority; lower numbers sort earlier. Default 0.

CreateScope.description: Where a root epic is created: the workspace (.omt/) home or the global per-user home. Only meaningful when parentId is absent.

RunStatus.description: Lifecycle state of a run batch.

RunItemState.description: Lifecycle state of one run member item.

RunReportOutcome.description: Executor-reported outcome for one claimed run item.

RunControlAction.description: Run lifecycle control. retry/remove additionally require nodeId to name the target member.

ActionParity.description: Action-parity classification (R22): agent_available actions expose identical qualified context on every consumer including MCP; adapter_only actions exist for a specific adapter channel (e.g. DSH UI bags); human_administrative actions are maintenance/administration reserved for humans via CLI/desktop.

ProblemCode.description: Stable machine-readable error code (R5). Open vocabulary: new codes may be added as long as they match the pattern; clients must treat unknown codes as their nearest coarse ancestor. See problems.schema.json for the seeded registry.

ProblemDetails.description: Machine-readable structured details of a problem (R5). Free-form object; each registry entry documents its own shape.

Problem.description: Structured problem carried in JSON-RPC error data (R5). message is diagnostic text only — assertions must key on code and details.

message.description: Human-readable diagnostic text. Not part of the contract surface.

NodeSummary.description: Lightweight qualified view of a ticket node.

NodeView.description: Full qualified view of a ticket node as persisted.

path.description: Markdown file path relative to the home root.

TreeNode.description: Recursive tree projection: a node summary plus its ordered subtree.

Progress.description: Member-state counts of a run. One key per RunItemState plus total.

RunConfig.description: Execution configuration of a run; omitted keys take documented defaults (stopOnFailure=false, autoContinue=true, autoVerify=false, concurrency=1).

RunView.description: Full qualified view of a run with derived progress.

stalledCount.description: Pending items whose continuation-nudge budget is exhausted.

RunItemView.description: Qualified view of one run member item.

executorActor.description: Actor namespace of the executor holding/last-holding this item.

stalled.description: Derived: pending item whose continuation-nudge budget is exhausted.

title.description: Joined node title (present in detail views).

RunLink.description: A non-terminal run holding a given ticket, as embedded in NodeDetail.

LeaseGrant.description: Fenced execution lease returned by a successful claim (R10). Reports must echo the token; expiry demotes the claim.

ClaimContextEntry.description: One read-only ancestor body included in claim context under the byte budget.

ClaimContext.description: Read-only execution context delivered with a claim: current item body plus budgeted ancestor background.

HomeInfo.description: One home exposed by the daemon during handshake.

path.description: Absolute path of the home bundle (informational).

ReindexResult.description: Outcome of a full reindex from Markdown to SQLite.

skipped.description: Entries skipped because they were illegal or unparseable.

SavedFilters.description: Opaque UI filter bag persisted per principal. The daemon stores it without interpreting it; the schema only pins it to an object.
